nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in New Jersey. The Giants have won three games, lost one and tied one.

news.headline: Chris Olave practiced Friday and may play
news.summary: The Saints' best receiver was sick and missed practice Wednesday and Thursday. He took part in some of Friday's practice, and the team lists him as a maybe for Sunday's game at the Giants.

news.headline: Two Saints defenders will miss Sunday's game
news.summary: Linebacker Kaden Elliss has a sore calf and Anfernee Jennings has a hurt knee, and neither one practiced this week. Running back Alvin Kamara is a maybe with a sore back.

news.headline: Jameis Winston is the Giants' quarterback now
news.summary: Winston played four years for the Saints and now starts for New York, after the Giants' young quarterback Jaxson Dart got hurt. The Giants have won two games and tied one in the games he has started, and Saints coaches spent this week saying good things about him.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Tramell Jones is ready if Philo cannot go
news.summary: Florida still lists quarterback Aaron Philo as questionable for Saturday at Texas with a hurt shoulder. If he cannot play, sophomore Tramell Jones Jr. will start in his place, and he has only played this year in games that were already decided.

news.headline: Florida may be without its quarterback at Texas
news.summary: Aaron Philo hurt his shoulder in Saturday's loss to South Carolina, and he has done only part of practice this week. If he cannot play Saturday at Texas, Tramell Jones Jr. would start for the first time.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III is practicing again
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver has practiced all week after hurting his knee and missing the last two games. He has a real chance to play Saturday at Texas.

nextGame.note: Late morning home game in Baton Rouge. Mississippi State is 4-1.

news.headline: LSU will be missing five players Saturday
news.summary: Thursday's league injury list has tight end Trey'Dez Green, linebackers Whit Weeks and Charles Ross II, safety Dashawn Spears and receiver Phillip Wright III all out against Mississippi State. Linebacker Tylen Singleton went from questionable to doubtful.

news.headline: Another LSU linebacker may miss Saturday
news.summary: Tylen Singleton is listed as questionable for the Mississippi State game. LSU has already lost Charles Ross II for the year and expects to be without Whit Weeks for most of it.

news.headline: Mississippi State's quarterback is a maybe for Saturday
news.summary: The league's Wednesday injury list has quarterback Kamario Taylor and leading runner Fluff Bothwell both listed as questionable, with a toe injury and an ankle injury. LSU will again be without tight end Trey'Dez Green and linebacker Whit Weeks.

nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games. Tulane is calling it Light it Uptown: the first 1,500 fans get light-up glasses, and there is a drone show at halftime and during the game.

news.headline: Two Tulane defensive linemen are day to day
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Kam Hamilton was hurt in the fourth quarter at Army and that Ed Smith IV did not play in that game. Hall called both of them day to day before Friday night's game with Memphis.

news.headline: Tulane has not named a quarterback for Friday
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that the job is open and that Tulane has to play better at quarterback. Three players have taken turns there this season.

news.headline: Tulane's last game is set for November 28
news.summary: The conference picked Saturday, November 28, for Tulane's trip to South Florida. The kickoff time and the TV channel will be announced about two weeks before the game.
